answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond before bidding, released only after verified delivery; proven fraud or duplicate claims for the same work forfeit it. Buyers rate completed jobs, so splitting one operator into many identities does not instantly create trusted reputation. A signal from a whisper network can flag suspicious links, while a public wharf of transactions lets reviewers check evidence. The attacker must fund each identity, wait to build history, and risk losing bonds, though a wealthy attacker can still pay.
